versions.changelog:
- Initial release of 元素融合创款 (1688-product-element-fusion).
- Supports extraction of creative elements (color, material, style, ambiance, patterns, composition) from inspiration images.
- Enables searching for real products on 1688 using element keywords and user-specified product categories.
- Provides material, style, craft, and cost research for matched products.
- Automatically generates practical and actionable product concept images based on researched fusion schemes.
- Includes full workflow with copyright prompts, compliance constraints, and user interaction for element and scheme selection.
